subject: Inquiry About Hiring a New AI Assistant -
body:
Dear Kaity,
I am reaching out to discuss hiring a new AI assistant for me. 
To ensure the best fit, I can share more details about:
•	The specific tasks or roles you'd like the AI assistant to handle (e.g., customer support, data analysis, drafting files).
•	Your preferred platform or integration requirements?
•	Any timelines or key objectives you're targeting?
•	Any cost limitation?
Feel free to schedule a call or reply with your thoughts. Looking forward to collaborating!
Best,
